WITH as_of AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' AS d),
members_at_date AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, m.tier
  FROM dim_member m, as_of
  WHERE m.valid_from <= as_of.d AND m.valid_to >= as_of.d AND m.join_date <= as_of.d
),
purchasers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  , as_of
  WHERE f.sale_date > as_of.d - INTERVAL 12 MONTH AND f.sale_date <= as_of.d
)
SELECT a.tier, count(*) AS active_members
FROM members_at_date a JOIN purchasers p USING (member_id)
GROUP BY a.tier
ORDER BY CASE a.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
